Fig. 3.2
The cylinder has length $5.8\text{ cm}$, cross-sectional area $1.2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}^2$ and weight $6.20\text{ N}$. The cylinder is in equilibrium when the extension of the spring is $4.0\text{ cm}$.
parts.text: Show that the upthrust acting on the cylinder is $0.60\text{ N}$.
